purpose: Faithfully test whether two real mandatory-overlap Skill-SP taxonomy witnesses propagate a semantics-preserving merge-versus-split control reparameterization into the generated task semantic distribution. Generate source-conditioned task banks once and reuse them for every counterfactual arm; no arm-specific model generation is allowed.
claim_boundary: P0-A can support or weaken C4 at the dynamic curriculum-distribution level. It does not establish downstream task-performance harm and does not test the SQC method. P0-B may reuse the same qualified raw bank with zero additional model calls if and only if P0-A supports both witness transformations.

generation.author_runtime: vllm.LLM + vllm.SamplingParams as in released question_generate.py

split.justification: Released reset-stat sampling weights are equal across the three frozen source packages.

merge_003_015.macro_semantics: The macro exposes exactly the same two underlying implementation prompts; it adds no implementation or validator support. Conditional implementation responsibility inside the macro is frozen 1/2,1/2.

merge_004_015.macro_semantics: The macro exposes exactly the same two underlying implementation prompts; it adds no implementation or validator support. Conditional implementation responsibility inside the macro is frozen 1/2,1/2.

representation_counterfactuals.only_treatment: grouping/mass over the same three frozen implementation-conditioned output banks

independent_truth.primary_semantic_observable: sorted full validator skill-ID acceptance pattern for each contract-valid generated task

frozen_released_support_prior_for_p0b_on.source: 530-row released API-Bank membership audit; restrict to rows accepted by at least one of skill_003/skill_004/skill_015

per_witness_dynamic_gate.threshold_provenance: identical to the preregistered thresholds in the invalid Qwen2.5 F0; not tuned after Qwen3 outcomes

decision_rule.GO: qualification passes and BOTH merge_003_015 vs split and merge_004_015 vs split pass all three dynamic gates
decision_rule.STOP: qualification passes and NEITHER witness passes all three dynamic gates
decision_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: qualification passes and exactly one witness passes all three dynamic gates
decision_rule.INVALID: qualification fails or provenance/hash/runtime contract fails

next_if_go: Freeze the raw generation bank and run P0-B support-quotient/rejection feasibility with zero additional model calls. Do not generate a second bank.
next_if_stop: Stop C4 dynamic propagation on this faithful Skill-SP local P0 and do not rescue by another backbone; retain C1/C2 control-plane/theory only.
next_if_inconclusive: Do not tune thresholds or add samples automatically. Human/paper-design review decides whether one-witness support is sufficient or the dynamic claim remains locked.
